main_measure.name: mean short-direction next-day excess return over cases (forecast < 0)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: >= 100 cases, mean > 0 with t >= 2 and slope > 0; reject: >= 100 cases, mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: slope of short excess next-day return on |forecast| (post_pipeline_value)

decided_by: Confirm rule: at least 100 cases, mean short-direction excess return above 0 with t >= 2, and supporting slope above 0.
reading: The situation is checked as the regime rule rebuilt from closes inside each window (1-day return > 0 and 3-day return < 0, short side), on active bars whose 3 prior closes are in the window, without recomputing the falling-agitated profile whose 365-day volatility percentile needs history the record does not hold; the coin's mean daily return is the mean of all its 1-day returns pooled over its windows; the day-clustered t sums the cases' deviations per UTC day, with a D/(D-1) correction; the slope uses cases with a recorded post_pipeline_value.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.005459 on the check folds against +0.007796 on every fold
